title: Erdos506: exact verification archive for the minimum-circle problem
description: A self-contained computer-assisted verification archive accompanying the preprint The Minimum Number of Circles Determined by Planar Point Sets under the Elliott-Purdy-Smith Convention. The release verifies f(8)=17 and f(n)=1+binom(n-1,2)-floor((n-1)/2) for every n>=9, including the finite terminals f(12)=51 and f(13)=61.
